nodes.description: Public view function that reads balances of multiple tokens for a given address.
Array of token contract addresses provided by the caller.
Address whose token balances are queried.
Return array storing the balance for each token.
Loop counter used to iterate over the _tokens array.
External call to ERC20Interface(_tokens[i]).balanceOf(_who) on an arbitrary token address.
Unchecked increment i++ on uint loop counter, which can overflow in Solidity 0.4.25.
